contract.note: Facts the gold SQL depends on. Phase P1 (the real seed) must satisfy them, or this file and the gold change together.
required_traps: shipping_country holds both UK and GB
csat_score null for open tickets and some closed ones
unit_price below list_price on about 12 percent of lines
refunds exist on paid, shipped or delivered orders (partial refunds)
payments.status takes captured, failed and refunded
orders 101..606 and tickets 301..303 and customers 77, 88 and product 17 exist
contract.active_customer_window: order_ts >= the first day of a window of N days that ENDS on and includes as_of (N=90: 2026-07-18; N=30: 2026-09-16) and before the day after as_of (2026-10-16); the glossary must state this boundary
contract.net_revenue_rule: revenue minus refund amounts of the same orders (paid, shipped or delivered), attributed to the month the ORDER was placed
